messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating staged rollout for api v2 -> /v2 endpoints
- Mode: canary
- Traffic: 5%
- Change window: 2026-03-22 03:00-04:00 UTC
- Rollback triggers: 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m OR client 4xx spike > 1% vs baseline
If issues, run `/deploy rollback api-v2`

priya: added release notes https://redwood.infer/release-notes/v2-rollout-20260322 :eyes: Please review and call out mobile SDK header-case note.

maria: ops — request pinlist for sensitive tenants: acme-corp, beta-shop, gov-edge. Can we pin them to v1 for the window?

josh: support here — acme-corp had intermittent 400s last week due to header-case mismatch. If pinned, I'll notify their account team.

sam: ops-rita can you run pins? deploy-bot can you accept the target list?

ops-rita: ack, will patch pinlist and confirm.

deploy-bot: received pin request. Running commands now:
```
/deploy pin api-v2 tenant=acme-corp until=2026-03-22T04:00Z
/deploy pin api-v2 tenant=beta-shop until=2026-03-22T04:00Z
/deploy pin api-v2 tenant=gov-edge until=2026-03-22T04:00Z
```
Pins applied. Confirm with `/deploy pins status`.

maria: also add mobile-sdk group to pinlist (mobile-batch-1) — clients that auto-upgrade are risky.

deploy-bot: pinned mobile-sdk=1.4.x label for group mobile-batch-1. Pins updated.

qa-lin: smoke tests queued against canary. I'll post failures here.

deploy-bot: canary health checks: latency p95 = 118ms (within target), error rate = 0.08% (below threshold). Telemetry: https://telemetry.redwood/streams/v2-canary
Canary will progress to 10% in 20m if no triggers.

priya: updated release notes to emphasize header-case fallback and added migration steps + FAQ.

josh: support team standing by. Drafted customer note for account teams.

maria: ops-rita — what's the rollback cadence if we see an issue? Immediate full rollback or staged?

ops-rita: immediate full rollback if 5xx > threshold for 5m. Otherwise we can pause/reduce traffic (5% -> 1% -> 0). `/deploy rollback api-v2` does immediate shift back to v1.

sam: small ops helper script for rollback (put in runbook):
```
# rollback helper
curl -X POST https://deploy.redwood/api/rollback -d '{"target":"api-v2"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_KEY'
```

qa-lin: one failing test: chat endpoint returns 400 on header-case mismatch in iOS simulator 14.9. Filed bug #4567.

priya: noted. ops-rita, recommend pin mobile-batch-1 until QA confirms patch.

ops-rita: pinning mobile-batch-1 now:
`/deploy pin api-v2 group=mobile-batch-1 until=2026-03-22T12:00Z`
Pin applied. Canary remains at 5% for other traffic.

release-eng: I'll be watching dashboards. QA + telemetry green at +20m -> give manual approval to progress.

deploy-bot: scheduled hold: wait_for_manual_approval=true; auto-progress cancelled.

sam: :thumbsup: adding a short checklist to the release runbook (pins present, release notes link, rollback cmd, telemetry link).

josh: support on standby. If we need to revert, I'll push a customer-facing note.

priya: summary: pins applied for acme-corp/beta-shop/gov-edge and mobile-batch-1, release notes updated, QA filed failing test, canary held pending manual signoff. Ops to monitor telemetry. I'll close thread after manual approval or rollback.

ops-rita: watching dashboards now. Ping me to rollback.

deploy-bot: closing thread (log id: deploy-8456789012).
